label: In the stated varying-domain alternative, each world has a witness but candidate a is actual at…
meaning: Evaluate explicit actual-domain assignments and token denotation, then apply the unchanged shared Kripke semantics to an accessible missing candidate and a possible different one. This is coherence relative to the alternative semantics, not a contradiction within Russell’s strict-name analysis. Stipulated mathematical test of issue #273, not a proof that Russell is false, that any actual ground exists, or that all why-questions have answers.
